scope: Official primary-source facts only; no comparative judgments. Excludes GLiNER, PP-LCNet, Docling, and Xberg.

candidates.title: MobileNetV4
candidates.published_updated: Official TensorFlow Models repo API fetched 2026-10-13 (updated_at 2026-10-13T06:30:10Z; pushed_at in API snapshot); paper 2024-04.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 repository code (GitHub license metadata NOASSERTION; verify weight artifact terms).
candidates.current_model_id: MobileNetV4 (Conv-S, Conv-M, Conv-L; Hybrid variants); Google research/Kaggle model artifacts
candidates.successor_evidence: Official paper presents MobileNetV4 as the newer MobileNet family; no later MobileNetV5 successor confirmed in reviewed sources
candidates.hardware: Designed for mobile/edge CPU and accelerator inference; official paper benchmarks on Pixel 8 CPU/GPU/NPU
candidates.limitations: Classifier backbone, not a general-purpose vision-language model; throughput depends on runtime, input resolution, quantization, and target device.

candidates.title: EfficientViT (MIT HAN Lab)

The cited arXiv:2205.14756 is correctly titled “EfficientViT: Multi-Scale Linear Attention for High-Resolution Dense Prediction” (ICCV 2023; revised 2024-02-06).

candidates.title: FastViT
candidates.license: Custom Apple ML Research License (repository LICENSE; not MIT/Apache). Verify pretrained weight terms as applicable.
candidates.current_model_id: Official Apple repo: FastViT model family/checkpoints; exact checkpoint inventory is in captured README.
candidates.successor_evidence: FasterViT is a separate NVIDIA paper/project; no official source found establishing it as a successor to Apple FastViT. Treat names as separate projects.
candidates.hardware: Apple describes mobile/edge efficiency; model implementation is PyTorch; deployment targets include mobile inference workflows
candidates.limitations: Classification-focused; published latency is device/runtime-specific and not a substitute for host CPU profiling.

candidates.limitations: Contrastive image/text embedding model rather than generative captioner; zero-shot results vary by dataset/domain and prompt.
